description: Flown battery-electric light aircraft for the electric_regression weight method. Masses in kg, power in kW (maximum take-off power, matching the sizing's installed power), energy in kWh. Every value comes from the listed sources (fetched 2026-11-03); conflicts are recorded in notes. battery_kg null means not published: the regression then estimates it from battery_kwh and the 'regression_pack_wh_kg' assumption (only if 'regression_estimate_battery' is on). include=false entries are kept for reference and can be added with the 'regression_add' assumption.

fields.empty_includes_battery: true/false as published; 'inferred' notes mark where the source does not say
fields.empty_excl_battery_kg: used directly when a source publishes empty mass without battery
fields.confidence: high = type-certificate data; medium = manufacturer data with minor conflicts; low = preliminary, inconsistent or secondary

aircraft.name: Pipistrel Velis Electro
aircraft.notes: TCDS: MTOM 600 kg, MTOP 57.6 kW (90 s), MCP 49.2 kW, ESS rated 2 x 11.0 kWh. Manufacturer: 428 kg basic empty with batteries, 24.8 kWh nominal, ~70 kg per pack x 2.

aircraft.name: Pipistrel Alpha Electro
aircraft.notes: Manufacturer: MTOW 472.5-550 kg, 368 kg empty with batteries, 21 kWh, 60 kW for 1 min. Aeropedia: 377 kg with batteries = 251 kg without + 126 kg battery system (consistent pair used here). Gear not stated in sources; fixed tricycle per type.

aircraft.name: Yuneec E430
aircraft.notes: MTOM conflict: 430 kg (New Atlas) vs 470 kg (Wikipedia, citing Yuneec 2008 spec). 178 kg without + 72 kg batteries = 250 kg with batteries. Battery pack count conflicts between sources. 13.8 m span motor-glider-like planform.

aircraft.name: Siemens/Magnus eFusion
aircraft.notes: Siemens: empty weight including batteries and parachute 410 kg; 45 kW MCP, 60 kW MTOP, 85 kW peak; battery 10.1 kWh. Battery mass not published (estimated by the regression). Aerobatic-capable Magnus Fusion airframe.

aircraft.name: Elektra Solar Elektra Trainer
aircraft.notes: Manufacturer: MTOW 600 kg, empty 400 kg with battery, 30 kWh standard (36 kWh option), HPD-50D 70 kW peak / 40 kW continuous, 14.5 m span. Standard gear is a retractable monowheel. Battery mass not published (estimated).

aircraft.name: Diamond eDA40
aircraft.notes: Diamond: 'calculated, preliminary' MTOM 1,310 kg, empty 1,130 kg, useful load 180 kg, 80 kWh, 125 kW. empty_includes_battery is inferred (no fuel; 1,130 + 180 = 1,310). Gear assumed fixed (DA40 airframe). Battery mass not published (estimated). Heavy four-seat-class airframe flown as a two-seater.

aircraft.name: Bye Aerospace eFlyer 2
aircraft.notes: Excluded by default: 2020 masses (1,900 / 1,460 lb) belong to the 90 kW Siemens configuration, the current 125 kW design has no published masses, and whether empty mass includes the ~90 kWh battery is not stated. Estimating the battery at ~170 Wh/kg leaves an implausibly light airframe.

aircraft.name: Airbus E-Fan 1.0
aircraft.notes: Excluded by default: battery mass conflicts (167 kg Wikipedia vs 137 kg aatlse), sources do not say whether the 500 kg empty mass includes the battery (assumed true here), and 500/550 kg leaves only ~50 kg useful load (demonstrator flown effectively single-pilot).

aircraft.name: Pipistrel WATTsUP
aircraft.notes: Excluded by default: published 251 kg without + 126 kg battery = 377 kg does not match the stated 314 kg with batteries (figures likely copied from Alpha Electro), so battery mass is left null. Motor power conflicts (50 vs 85 kW).

aircraft.name: Pipistrel Taurus Electro
aircraft.notes: Excluded by default: self-launching glider with a 4.75 kWh launch-only pack, not a cruise-sized electric aircraft. MTOW listed as 450 / 472.5 / 550 kg.

aircraft.name: Lange Antares 20E
aircraft.notes: Excluded: single-seat sailplane, MTOM includes water ballast, battery energy and mass not published. Kept for reference only; cannot be added (no battery data).

no_mass_data: BRM Aero Bristell B23 Energic: MTOM 850 kg, 48-49 kWh, 100 kW MTOP; empty mass not published (avpay.aero, AIN 2026-04-27)
IFB Stuttgart e-Genius: MTOM 850-950 kg, 300 kg battery, 56 kWh; empty mass not published
Extra 330LE: MTOM 1,000 kg, 260 kW; empty and battery mass not published
Aura Aero Integral E: 215 kg battery, 150 kW; MTOM not published
Bye eFlyer 4 and Sonex ESA: concepts, not flown
